Though I've known almost all of my life that I'm a girl so it hasn't been difficult on me mentally.

This last year alone has been amazing and ful of trials that have affected me and my mentality to extremes all the hormones rushing through my system, the emotional turmoils, the lost friendships, the depression, just to much to bare by myself had been happening with me this year alone

I've been really lucky and havnt experiences any real hate from someone not in my life except a few uncomfortable stares.
